_help: Amazon Associates infrastructure. amazon_nl_tag is the amazon.nl Associates tag. Both English and Dutch pages link to amazon.nl with that tag, because the account is registered on amazon.nl and the tag is not credited on amazon.com. amazon_com_tag stays empty until a separate amazon.com account exists; it is not added to links. An empty amazon_nl_tag hides the accessory box and the Amazon section on About and Privacy. Every href is an Amazon.nl search URL (the k parameter). Do not put an ASIN, a /dp/ link, a price or a rating here. topics decide which articles show the row: charging (charging articles, plus a model article that is about a charge adapter), owner (buying and owning a passenger Tesla), dashcam (Sentry Mode), tyres (tyres, winter, maintenance).
